title: An ending of the campaign and its epilogue slides (ADR 0014, docs/contracts/campaign.md Endings)

topic.description: What the slide is about (vallaki, ireena ...). A topic is shown once: the first slide of it whose `when` holds, this ending's own slides before the ones it inherits.

when.description: A dialogue condition (docs/contracts/dialogue.md); empty is always.

text.description: Our own words, one or two sentences. {name} is the heir (the bearer of the Second Thirst) or else the leader; {leader} is the leader.

portrait.description: An art/portraits id, or {name} for the heir's (or leader's) own portrait.

summary.description: One line under the title card, and the finished save's note.

priority.description: The highest-priority ending whose `when` holds is the one reached.

narration.description: The .dialogue node played first (file:node under narrative/).

tone.description: The ending screen's light: a pale dawn, the valley's night, or the castle's red.

music.description: The art/audio.json mood the ending screen plays (default: ending).

epilogue_from.description: Another ending whose slides follow this one's (topics already shown are skipped).
